learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic principles of the different subjects that make up this applied and professional module.
Formulate and solve problems posed in the different subjects.
Conduct market prospecting on products related to the different subjects presented, detect the advantages and disadvantages of the products, considering their economic and environmental cost.
Propose systems and carry out simulations and real projects related to the different subjects.

syllabus_topics: External combustion engines
Reciprocating internal combustion engines: spark-ignition and compression-ignition
Steam and gas turbines
Theme 1 - The thermal engine
Theme 2 - Reciprocating internal combustion engines
Theme 3 - Thermodynamic cycles
Theme 4 - Fuels
Theme 5 - Spark-ignition engine combustion
Theme 6 - Compression-ignition engine combustion
Theme 7 - Pollution
Theme 8 - Charge renewal in 4-stroke and 2-stroke reciprocating internal combustion engines
Theme 9 - Supercharging
Theme 10 - Fuel supply in reciprocating internal combustion engines
Theme 11 - Characteristic curves of reciprocating internal combustion engines. Engine testing.
Theme 12 - Use of Hydrogen in ICIE. Technologies.
Theme 13 - Problems of reciprocating internal combustion engines.
Theme 14 - Appendix. Elements of ICIE.
Laboratory Practice 1 - Engine practice. Includes: Engine components: Description and visualization in the workshop.
Laboratory Practice 2 - Ignition systems in spark-ignition engines. Includes: Ignition systems in SI engines: Description, measurement, and parameters to consider.
Laboratory Practice 3 - Gasoline injection systems. Includes: Indirect injection systems in SI engines: Description, simulation of real processes, measurement of engine operating parameters.
Laboratory Practice 4 - Exhaust gas analysis. Includes: Emissions in RICE: Measurement of smoke in CI and SI engines.

Laboratory Practice 5 - Performance analysis of a reciprocating internal combustion engine on a test bench. Includes: Engine test bench: Description, typical tests, and generation of engine operating maps.

assessment_methods.method: Identification of key concepts and comprehension of theoretical and operational knowledge of the subject. Long answer tests

assessment_rules: Long answer tests and multiple-choice tests are recoverable through a written test. Experimental work tests and reports are recoverable only if the submitted practice guides are failed, also via an individual written test. It is necessary to obtain a minimum of 5 out of 10 in the sum of the long answer and multiple-choice tests. Attendance at practical sessions and submission of practical work are mandatory to pass the subject. Active participation in theoretical classes will positively contribute to the final grade.
